caption_L1: This bar chart is titled Holders of the U.S. government debt as of December 2019. The y-axis plots Response as a categorical scale starting at Depository institutions and ending at U.S. savings bonds. There is a linear scale with a minimum of 0.0 and a maximum of 0.4 along the x-axis, labeled Share of debt holders.
caption_L2L3: The graph clearly shows the two largest holders of US government debt at this time are the Federal Reserve and Government, and Foreign and International, with 0.35 and 0.28 share respectively. The next two highest are Other Investors and Mutual Funds at 0.11 and 0.1 share respectively. All the other groups are much lower.
